summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Tier 2 Weighted-Average Inventory Module. Wrote 9 pytest tests covering items catalog inventory fields, bill weighted-avg hook, invoice COGS hook, negative-QOH warn-but-allow, manual adjustments + movements, valuation report, bill delete reversal, invoice delta-based delete reversal, and draft-skip. All 9 tests PASSED. Frontend /inventory-management page loads with 3 tabs (Valuation default, Movements, Adjustments) with no console errors, sidebar Inventory link is correctly placed between Loans and Tags, Items modal 'Track inventory' checkbox reveals inventory sub-form with Opening QOH, Opening avg cost, Inventory Asset Account (auto-picks '1300 · Inventory'), COGS Account (auto-picks 'COGS - Materials'), and Low-stock threshold — matches spec exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_service._reverse_bill_hooks: when new_qoh (post-reversal) equals 0, cost_basis is reset to pre.cost_basis — reasonable, but with base_qoh<=0 the weighted-avg on next purchase re-uses the incoming unit cost only. Edge-case OK for now.
routes/bills.py delete_bill swallows inventory reversal exceptions silently (try/except: pass). If reversal fails the bill is still deleted, leaving orphan JEs. Consider logging.
inventory_service.apply_adjustment posts JE using target_cost even when only qty_delta is provided; for large delta with a pre_cost of 0 the JE value is 0 — acceptable but subtle.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_INV_* items, TEST_B_* bill, TEST_I_* invoice and tear them down at module exit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inventory tier 2 fully validated end-to-end. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_inventory_tier2.py can be run as regression. Frontend Items modal correctly auto-picks Inventory (1300) and COGS - Materials accounts for tracked items.
